articles.title: Nichirei (TSE:2871), What Is Drawing Fresh Attention Now?
articles.summary: Oasis Management’s activist campaign at Nichirei (TSE:2871) moved into the spotlight on 10 September 2026, as the fund outlined proposals on assets, borrowings, governance, business portfolio and capital returns. Nichirei’s shares have been on a solid run, with a 19.5% year to date share price return and a 30.92% total shareholder return over the past year.
